The City of Chanhassen, Minnesota, has two distinct adoption timelines for its Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) ordinances:
• Initial ADU Ordinance (1986): Chanhassen first adopted rules for ADUs in 1986. However, this original structure required homeowners to apply for a variance to permit a single-family dwelling to be used as a two-family home or ADU.
• Detached ADU Ordinance (June 9, 2025): The Chanhassen City Council unanimously voted to adopt an ordinance amendment officially allowing the construction of Detached Accessory Dwelling Units
